name: PerfectEssayWriter.ai
description_en:
PerfectEssayWriter.ai generates essay drafts from a topic, assignment prompt or rubric with controls for academic level, essay type, page count and citation format. Its wider suite includes outlining, rewriting, checking and reference tools.

A useful output is a draft to inspect against the assignment and primary references. Generated arguments, source existence and quoted findings require review; formatting a reference does not establish its accuracy or make the work ready to submit.
description_zh:
PerfectEssayWriter.ai 从主题、任务或评分标准生成论文初稿，可设置学术级别、体裁、页数及引用格式，并提供提纲、改写、检查和参考工具。

可用结果应是对照任务和原始来源核查的初稿。论点、来源是否存在及发现内容都需审核；参考格式正确不代表事实正确或可直接提交。

core_features.explanation_en: Set level, structure, length and citation style before drafting.
core_features.explanation_zh: 起草前设级别、结构、长度和引用格式。

core_features.explanation_en: The page presents PDF/Word and Drive output routes with account conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 页面列 PDF/Word 及 Drive 输出路径，并有账户条件。

en: Compare an allowed essay outline against its rubric and verified references.
zh: 将获允许论文提纲与评分标准及真实文献比较。
use_cases.basis: Editorial task suggestions based on official documentation; no observed deployment.

steps.en: Set a small assignment, review each claim and reference, then inspect the exported document.
steps.zh: 设小任务、审核各主张和引用，再检查导出文件。

items.en: Selection judgments and examples are documentation-based; no live workflow was tested.
items.zh: 选型判断与例子依据文档，未实测真实流程。

sources.title: Free AI Essay Writer - Write Any Essay in Minutes | PerfectEssayWriter.ai
sources.research_notes_en: Pricing read from official homepage FAQ because standalone pricing returned 404; three anonymous generations, free-account wording and paid word tiers need billing confirmation.

official_check.scope: Public official documents read; no purchase, account setup, independent review, hands-on test, identity verification or publication approval.

review_notes: Official documentation describes vendor functionality, not independent evidence of reliability, adoption or outcomes.
Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese draft; examples and fit judgments are editorial guidance.
Current public pricing is a dated snapshot; purchase conditions remain subject to vendor confirmation.

sections.title_en: Turn the rubric into review criteria
sections.title_zh: 把评分标准变成审核条件
sections.en: For an illustrative comparison essay, identify the two positions and the evidence required for each. Supply only authorized course material and inspect whether the outline addresses the actual prompt. Page-count settings are not a guarantee of argument depth. A personal statement also requires authentic experiences that a generator cannot establish.
sections.zh: 例如比较论文，应明确双方立场和各自证据，只提供有权使用课程材料，并检查提纲是否回应任务。页数不保证论证深度，个人陈述也需生成器无法确立的真实经历。

sections.en: The homepage claims real references and plagiarism-free output, but also states that no writer can guarantee undetectability. Open every reference, verify author/date and confirm that it supports the sentence. A low similarity or detector score cannot replace this check. Follow the institution’s permitted-use rules and retain your own reasoning rather than submit an untouched draft.
sections.zh: 首页声称真实引用及无抄袭，同时说明无法保证不可检测。应打开每条来源、核作者日期及是否支持句子，低相似度或检测分数不能替代核查。应遵循机构允许范围并保留个人推理，不能直接提交未审初稿。

sections.title_en: Distinguish free generations from monthly words
sections.title_zh: 区分免费生成次数与月词数
sections.en: The homepage describes three anonymous generations, then a free account with up to 1,500 words per generation; another message says 1,500 more free words. It lists Starter $4.15/month for 15,000 words, Writer $6.99 for 75,000 and Unlimited $9.99. Billing commitment and the exact free-account allowance are not established. The linked standalone pricing page returned 404, so these are homepage statements rather than a checkout quote.
sections.zh: 首页称匿名 3 次、免费账户每次最多 1,500 词，但另提示再送 1,500 免费词。Starter 月 $4.15/15,000 词，Writer $6.99/75,000，Unlimited $9.99，账期承诺及免费账户额度未明。独立价格页返回 404，因此只是首页表述而非结算报价。

sections.title_en: Evaluate the draft and document, not the promise
sections.title_zh: 评估初稿和文件而非宣传承诺
sections.en: This merits investigation for outlining and draft comparison where assistance is permitted. Test one small assignment, check the sources and inspect the exported reference list. No essay, rubric upload, detector, plagiarism check or download was executed. The page inconsistently counts thirty-two and thirty-eight tools; no complete entitlement inventory is inferred.
sections.zh: 允许辅助写作时可研究提纲及初稿比较。建议小任务试用、核来源并检查导出参考文献。本文未生成论文、上传标准、运行检测或下载。页面工具数量 32/38 不一致，不能推断完整权益清单。

research_gaps: Pricing URL returned 404; homepage billing, free-account allowance and tool count are inconsistent or incomplete.
No generation, citation accuracy, export, data terms, license or self-hosting verified.
